item.title: Lollapalooza 2026: Highlight Performances From Zara Larsson, Tate McRae, Aespa & Jennie | All Access
item.description:
Here's a short and engaging podcast script based on the article:
[Intro music fades out]
Host: Welcome to our podcast, where we bring you the latest from the world of music. Today, we're taking you to Lollapalooza 2026 in Chicago, where some of the hottest stars took the stage. I'm your host, Tetris Kelly.
[Short music transition]
Host: We got to hang out with some amazing artists, including Aespa, CORTIS, and Zara Larsson. But first, let's talk about day one. We kicked things off with SB19, who performed their new song "Lawless" for the very first time. I caught up with them after their set.
[Short clip of SB19's interview]
Host: As SB19 said, performing at Lollapalooza can be overwhelming, but they definitely brought the energy. Night one was all about the parties, with surprise performances by Lil Sims and Flavor Flav with Public Enemy. We also saw electric sets by YUNGBLUD and Slayyyter.
[Short music transition]
Host: On day two, we spent the morning with CORTIS at the House of Blues. Then, we chatted with Whitney Whitney about her journey to Lolla and overcoming the challenge of losing her voice.
[Short clip of Whitney Whitney's interview]
Host: It's inspiring to see artists like Whitney Whitney persevere and share their talents with the world. Other highlights from Lollapalooza included performances by Tate McRae, JENNIE, and Aespa.
[Outro music starts playing]
Host: That's a wrap from Lollapalooza 2026 in Chicago. Thanks for tuning in to our podcast. If you want to see more from the festival, be sure to check out the full video online.
[Outro music continues to play until the end]
